svg.title: joflux
svg.desc: Repository migration. Moves a whole GitHub organisation into Forgejo or Codeberg in five stages, and never deletes the originals. Built in: Python, standard library only. Ships as: Homebrew tap. Install: brew tap netspeedy/joflux, then brew install joflux.
svg.text: Moves a whole GitHub organisation into Forgejo or Codeberg in five
stages, and never deletes the originals.
